$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the fund-index pack composed as a one-line fund site — Stet, a two-partner $60M pre-seed fund in New York — on its own register (galleyproof), content seed and page skeletons. Everything else — pages, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Stet
description: A venture fund site that is one line: the fund's thesis set alone on the first screen at poster scale in a degraded proof serif, its full stop the only red on the page, the facts in one mono slug above it and the pitch beneath; below the fold, the portfolio as a single comma-run of names and the ask as one closing line with an arrow. No photography — the type is the image. The inner pages keep the fund-index machinery: a filterable portfolio whose counts, sector chips, and status pills compute themselves, the team, dated letters newest-first, a pitch form, and the disclosures typeset in full.

theme.$comment: Proof red as the brand over the galleyproof register's bone paper: a theme brand overlay is the accent, so the one red the register keeps — the full stop, the links, the submit — is the brand, and app-side surfaces carry the same pencil mark. mode light opens the site in its native reading (dark is the same proof under a desk lamp). navigation re-pins the shared fundIndexShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the wordmark and a burger, nothing else over the line.

landing.$comment: The one-line home (fundIndexLanding.ts lineHome, switched on by the seed's home.line): the statement hero with its badge — which the proofmark treatment sets full-screen — the portfolio as a text-logos comma-run, and the deck ask as a colophon. The inner pages pin the base skeletons unchanged. The galleyproof register replaces the base's achromatic mono-utility style wholesale, overrides included.
